notes.title: The Battleship Domination Tournament has begun!
notes.notes:
Join us for Battleship Domination LIVE — the ultimate Battleship Tournament that will see members of the Marmalade Game Studio team waging war on the high seas!

Follow us and catch the action as it unfolds here https://www.twitch.tv/marmaladegamestudio


But don’t let us have all the fun! [b]Hold your own Tournament and share your stories[/b]. Tell us your epic tales, share screenshots of the action and/or record your games. We’ll share the best stories on our social channels and [b]our favourite will win these awesome prizes*: [/b]

In honour of our mighty Viking Commander, Astrid Stormur, the winner will receive the Viking Longship lego set worth £104.99, plus a Battleship hoodie and a Tournament Trophy!

Tune in, get involved, and Dominate your enemies in Battleship Domination LIVE!

notes.title: Version 1.3.7
notes.notes: Fixed the issue preventing some players from matchmaking with friends with an "Invalid Code", even when the code was correct.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.3.5
notes.notes:
[b]THIS JUST IN[/b]

We’ve put out an emergency patch to resolve the issues caused by version 1.3.4. The problems regarding click-to-fire should now be resolved. And the online multiplayer issues should be improved. We’re working hard to return the game to it’s normal state and beyond!

Thank you for bringing these bugs to our attention so quickly, new and battle-hardened naval officers both! We really do appreciate it, and we thank you for your patience.

Stand by for further updates!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33265122/098a8c636ef8f7f92af791dfc0e5216f1e8eac86.png[/img]

[i]Changelog:
- Fixed the Invalid Code issue
- Improved multiplayer stability
- Click-to-fire issue resolved.[/i]

notes.title: It’s here! THE GAME OF LIFE 2 is now available on Steam!
notes.notes:
It’s taken iOS and Android by storm; it’s nominated for 2 TIGA Awards; it’s the official, contemporary sequel to one of the most popular board games of all time!

Set out on a new LIFE adventure, with more choices and more freedom than ever before! Updated to reflect modern values and life experiences, this time you’ll face additional big, path altering decisions further down the road, and have the chance to earn more in life than just money. Collect points for Happiness and Knowledge as well as Wealth!

Get married early and start a family, or stay single, adopt a pet, and save finding that special someone until later in life. Every decision counts! Choose to invest for Wealth points, take a trip and boost your Happiness, or go back to college and get another degree! All can lead to victory.

Available for cross-platform multiplayer gaming on Steam and mobile, you can challenge friends and family, whether they’re on PC, iOS or Android!

In THE GAME OF LIFE 2 there are so many more ways to win! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1455630/THE_GAME_OF_LIFE_2/]Play now[/url]!

notes.title: Get ready, THE GAME OF LIFE 2 is coming!
notes.notes:
If you enjoyed Battleship, then we have another fantastic digital board game for you! It’s almost time to live a new LIFE on PC. The official contemporary sequel to one of the world’s most popular board games is coming soon to Steam! With more choices and more freedom than ever before, there’s a thousand new ways to live in THE GAME OF LIFE 2! 

This time there’s more to winning the game than just money. Gain points for Happiness, Knowledge and Wealth, and make your choices count.

It’s multiplayer fun on PC and mobile, with cross-platform gaming. So you can challenge friends and family to a game whether they’re on PC, iPhone or Android! Will you get married or stay single? Have a baby, or adopt a pet? Be a Video Blogger, or go to college and become a Robotics Engineer? The choice is yours!

THE GAME OF LIFE 2 coming soon to Steam. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/<512260>]Add it to your wishlist today![/url]
